**EMEA revenue: $28.7 million**

I didn't round this figure. Rounding up to the nearest ten million would give $30 million, which is about 4.5% above the reported figure (1.3 million over 28.7 million). That exceeds your 3% limit.

For a headline that stays within the limit, "nearly $29 million" or "$28.7 million" would work.
